message: Negative amount without a credit-note reference; row excluded.
risk: Row is excluded; totals may be wrong in either direction.
proposed_action: Check the source document; re-enter as a credit note with reference if it is a credit.

message: Invoice date '2026-13-45' is not a valid date; row excluded.
risk: Amount cannot be assigned to a period; actuals may be understated.
proposed_action: Correct the invoice date in the source ledger and re-run the report.

message: Decision DEC-021 (approved) has no authorised approver role (found: 'blank').
risk: An approval exists without an accountable approver; the decision is not auditable.
proposed_action: Confirm who approved and complete the decision record; until then treat the approval as unconfirmed.

message: Ledger shows 3,800 EUR recognised, linked valid invoices total 4,800 EUR.
risk: Open commitment and forecast are wrong by the difference.
proposed_action: Reconcile the purchase order ledger with the invoices and correct the recognised amount.

message: Cost centre 'CC-UNKNOWN-99' has no budget; amount is reported as unmapped spend.
risk: Spend is not allocated to any budget; cost-centre totals are incomplete.
proposed_action: Assign the invoice to a valid cost centre.

message: Amount is in 'USD' and no approved conversion rate to EUR exists; row excluded and reported in USD, not added to any EUR figure.
risk: Amount is excluded; actuals may be understated.
proposed_action: Provide the EUR value booked in the ledger or an approved conversion rate.

message: Network and Access is allocated 390 h against 360 h available (30 h over). Approved demands in this month: ORION-REQ-019.
risk: Committed delivery dates are at risk; the team is promised more hours than it has.
proposed_action: Re-plan with the delivery lead: move a start date, release run work, or defer one approved demand.

message: Invoice id INV-0021 appears more than once; counted once.
risk: Spend would be overstated if both rows were counted.
proposed_action: Confirm with accounts payable which row is valid and remove the duplicate from the ledger export.

message: Forecast at completion 228,800 EUR exceeds the period budget of 225,000 EUR.
risk: Cost centre is forecast to exceed its approved budget.
proposed_action: Decide: defer uncommitted work, reallocate budget from a cost centre with headroom, or request a budget increase.

message: EVT-0248: transition SUBMITTED -> ASSESSMENT is not allowed.
risk: Status history skips a control step.
proposed_action: Correct the history entry or repeat the skipped step.

message: Cost centre '' is missing or has no budget.
risk: Cost cannot be checked against a budget; the funding gate is unavailable.
proposed_action: Ask the requester for the funding cost centre.

message: Open demand in status Assessment has no assigned owner.
risk: Nobody is accountable for moving the demand forward.

message: Open demand in status Submitted has no assigned owner.
risk: Nobody is accountable for moving the demand forward.

message: Open demand in status Submitted has no assigned owner.
risk: Nobody is accountable for moving the demand forward.

message: Invoice refers to demand 'ORION-REQ-999', which does not exist.
risk: Spend cannot be traced to a demand.
proposed_action: Link the invoice to the correct demand or mark it as run cost.

message: Recognised 4,600 EUR exceeds the approved commitment of 4,000 EUR.
risk: More was invoiced than was approved on the purchase order.
proposed_action: Check for scope change; raise a purchase order amendment for approval if justified.

message: Register says SUBMITTED, latest history entry EVT-0248 says ASSESSMENT.
risk: Register and status history disagree; counts by status may be wrong.
proposed_action: Confirm the true status with the owner and correct the wrong source.

message: Spend booked on ORION-REQ-028 without an approval decision at the invoice date.
risk: Money was spent before a funding decision; the approval control was bypassed.
proposed_action: Clarify who ordered the work; bring the demand to the next board or reverse the booking.

message: Invoice dated 2026-11-20 is after the cutoff and not included.
risk: None for this report; the amount appears in the next period.
